name: spinocerebellar ataxia 48
description: A form of spinocerebellar ataxia, a clinically and genetically heterogeneous group of cerebellar disorders. Patients show progressive incoordination of gait and often poor coordination of hands, speech and eye movements, due to degeneration of the cerebellum with variable involvement of the brainstem and spinal cord. SCA48 is an autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disease characterized by onset in mid-adulthood of progressive cognitive decline and gait ataxia, and vermian and hemispheric cerebellar atrophy.
